database: disposable schema-only copy; dropped after test

results.name: all 92 operations are registered in Swagger and protected before dispatch
signup is atomic and forces patient role; duplicate registration is rejected
profile changes persist and cannot change identity or privileges
topology CRUD persists aliases and enforces admin and foreign keys
permission grants are idempotent and revoke correctly
remaining administration routes persist account, role and assignment changes
record creation is scoped and creates chronic subtype atomically
concurrent acceptance has one winner and persists the assigned visit
daily UAS is generated by PostgreSQL and duplicate submissions are serialized
prescribing is restricted to the assigned doctor and rolls back invalid medicines
private uploads persist, reject cross-patient links and protect downloads
completion is assigned-doctor-only and cannot repeat or prescribe afterwards
every unsupported schema operation returns 501 without fake success
password changes and logout revoke sessions
every mapped operation has at least one successful real HTTP request
